name: CHARLTON, the Hon. Dr Andrew Henry George

headline.note: The official timeline identifies university, international-development, political-staff, Wesfarmers, AlphaBeta and Accenture roles, but does not establish substantive full-time status or exact boundaries for the potentially countable private-sector spells. University research, political staff, study, campaigning and elected office are excluded. Missing evidence is not zero.

career_spells.evidence_note: Published biographies identify the degree and University Medal, but enrolment/completion dates, study load and any concurrent employment are unresolved.
career_spells.counting_note: Study is excluded under the codebook.

career_spells.role: Rhodes Scholar; economics master's and doctoral study
career_spells.evidence_note: Published biographies identify Rhodes Scholarship and graduate economics qualifications. Exact enrolment and completion dates, load and overlap with UNDP or LSE work are unresolved.
career_spells.counting_note: Study is excluded under the codebook.

career_spells.evidence_note: The frozen official parliamentary occupation extract records an analyst role in 2003. Duty station, exact dates, contract/payroll entity, hours and overlap with study are not recorded.
career_spells.counting_note: Employment by a multilateral international organisation is outside the domestic public/private headline sectors and excluded.

career_spells.employer: London School of Economics and Political Science
career_spells.evidence_note: The frozen official biography records 2005–2008. Exact appointment dates, employing centre, hours, leave and overlap with doctoral study or government work are unresolved.
career_spells.counting_note: University employment is excluded under the project codebook.

career_spells.employer: Office of Prime Minister Kevin Rudd (payroll entity unresolved)
career_spells.role: Senior/Chief Economic Adviser and G20 Sherpa
career_spells.evidence_note: The frozen official biography gives 2008–2010 and identifies the senior adviser and G20 Sherpa roles. The Labor biography says he joined the new government in 2007; secondary reporting supplies December 2007–June 2010, but primary month-level appointment evidence was not located, so the record retains the frozen year precision. Exact appointment/payroll dates, hours and the LSE overlap remain unresolved.
career_spells.counting_note: Political staff employment is excluded under the codebook.

career_spells.evidence_note: The frozen official occupation extract and a public employer-event biography record a Wesfarmers role from 2010 to 2014. Contemporaneous reporting places recruitment after the June 2010 government transition. Exact start/end dates, business unit, substantive full-time status and leave are unresolved.
career_spells.counting_note: Wesfarmers was privately controlled, but year-only dates and unproven full-time status do not support an exact headline duration.

career_spells.evidence_note: The frozen official biography records 2015–2020. Accenture's acquisition announcement says AlphaBeta was founded in 2015, identifies Charlton as founder/director, states it was privately held and records simultaneous signing and closing on 27 February 2020. Exact 2015 start date, hours, leave and any transition from Wesfarmers are unresolved.
career_spells.counting_note: Private ownership and the acquisition endpoint are supported, but substantive full-time status and an exact start boundary are not.

career_spells.role: Managing Director; Sustainability Services Lead for Growth Markets
career_spells.evidence_note: The frozen official biography records Managing Director, 2020–2022. Accenture's 27 February 2020 acquisition establishes the transition from AlphaBeta into Accenture; secondary reporting identifies the later sustainability leadership title. The exact cessation date, hours, leave and campaign overlap are unresolved.
career_spells.counting_note: Private employment is supported, but no exact substantive full-time interval is established.

career_spells.evidence_note: Published reporting records endorsement as Labor candidate on 1 April 2022. Pay, hours, formal employment status and overlap with Accenture are unresolved.
career_spells.counting_note: Party/campaign activity is excluded under the codebook.

career_spells.evidence_note: The frozen roster establishes House service from 21 May 2022. Current ministerial duties are nested within elected service and do not create a second employment spell.
career_spells.counting_note: Elected office is excluded under the codebook.

research_notes: The frozen official occupation extract provides the backbone of the timeline but only year-level boundaries and no working-hours evidence.
The AlphaBeta acquisition date is exact primary-employer evidence; it does not prove that every preceding or succeeding day was substantive full-time work.
Senior, founder and managing-director titles are not treated as proof of full-time hours.
Potential overlap among Oxford study, LSE research and the December 2007 government appointment remains explicit.
